Ready for approval. Terminal inspection confirmed the configured immutable kit pin, gpt-6.1-sol with max reasoning, discovery-only composition and matching managed-file hashes. The tracked source contains no application implementation or consumer runtime patch files.

The checkout lacks eight tracked skills and .codex/config.toml; their committed Git blobs remain readable. Live host, GitHub and effective model execution facts remain unverified.

Please review the specification for issue #2 and use the exact approval command the controller posts. The [installed nexkit-request skill](/home/nexkit-agent/work/.agents/skills/nexkit-request/SKILL.md) requires: “Ask an authorized collaborator to review the current issue and post the bot's `/nexkit approve <hash>` command.” The accepted project policy applies this gate to read-only discovery.

**Ready for requirement approval.** A collaborator with write, maintain or admin access can approve this version by commenting:

`/nexkit approve 9a1d3f177a2765a69bfae0055891213b4393c40e26fffc7bdc26f3bcc39b2b77`

Read the specification above before approving. If it needs changes, discuss them on this issue and update the specification before approving its new version.
